shots.focal_element: Large black headline 'Work Sprawl / is killing us.' surrounded by a pink flowchart of pain-point boxes, then a travelling black line that leads into 'Too many apps...' with orbiting app icons
shots.transition_other: video start: opens on a near-blank light frame with a soft pink gradient at the bottom; the headline builds on (no incoming transition)
on_screen_text: 1. Is this a PRIORITY? 2. HOW will work get done? 3. WHO will do the work? 4. Do we have all the REQUIRED info?
8 HOURS SPENT and still unsure if it moved the needle
NAVIGATING A MAZE of disconnected apps
shots.typography: Headline in a heavy geometric sans (low-confidence guess: Plus Jakarta Sans or similar), sentence/title case, tight negative tracking; words appear one by one with the not-yet-spoken word in light grey then turning black (karaoke-style emphasis). Diagram boxes use small regular-weight text with ALL-CAPS bold keywords in the accent colour. Small grey ClickUp wordmark watermark bottom-right throughout.
shots.what_happens: Words 'Work Sprawl is killing us.' type on word-by-word in sync with the VO (w0-w4) while a pink flowchart of workplace pain points draws in around them with arrows; the camera pushes right into the diagram, a black line with a dot head sweeps the frame clean, 'Too many' builds word-by-word on the line (w8-w10) and app logo tiles with red notification badges swirl in on tangled curves around 'Too many apps...'; at the end a dark organic ink shape wipes in from the left carrying 'Too many AI...'.
shots.build_rebuild: Stack a bold headline whose words flip from grey to black on VO word timestamps, stagger-draw an SVG flowchart of rounded pink boxes with stroke-dashoffset arrows behind it, then animate a thick black path with a circular head across the frame (motion-path) that wipes to a second line of kinetic type ringed by app-icon cards orbiting on bezier paths.

shots.focal_element: White headline text on a dark grainy purple-navy background ('Too many AI tools...', then 'Context is lost.') wrapped by a single white continuous line
on_screen_text: Can you send me the Q4 numbers?
shots.typography: Headlines in the same heavy geometric sans, white, sentence case, tight tracking; 'Context is lost.' enters with a strong horizontal motion blur. Question chips are small medium-weight white text inside translucent grey rounded pills with a chat icon; several are too small to read with certainty.
shots.what_happens: The white line from the previous shot loops into large hairpin curves carrying circular AI-tool logo badges beside 'Too many AI tools...' (w11-w14); the line straightens into a branching circuit-like tree as 'Context is lost.' slides in with motion blur (w15-w18); question chips pop onto the branch ends and the line spirals into overlapping loops below; the camera then tracks along a branch to a 'How do I do this?' chip and a line end-dot swells into a large white circle that fills the frame.
shots.build_rebuild: On a dark grain-textured gradient, animate one white SVG stroke with stroke-dashoffset through hairpin loops then a branching tree, pop rounded translucent chat-chip labels at branch tips with a short stagger, slide the headline in with a horizontal blur filter, and end by scaling the line's end-dot up to cover the screen.

shots.focal_element: Rotated two-line type lockup 'Work sprawl kills / human productivity'
shots.typography: Small grey medium-weight kicker 'Work sprawl kills' above a large heavy black 'human productivity', lowercase sentence case, tight tracking; letters of 'productivity' arrive individually with wide spacing and shrinking scale before settling, the whole lockup set on a diagonal tilt.
shots.what_happens: On a white grain-speckled background the tilted lockup scales up while the letters of 'productivity' fly in one by one and tighten into place in time with the VO (w19-w23); a black line with a dot head swoops in from the top right.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a rotated (about -10 degrees) two-line text group on a white noise-textured background, scale the group up over the shot and stagger each letter of the second line in from wide letter-spacing and small scale to rest, while a black SVG path with a circular head draws in from the corner.

shots.focal_element: Extreme close-up of the black letters of 'productivity' and the black line that dives into the letter 'o'
shots.typography: Same heavy black geometric sans at very large scale with letters bouncing on an uneven baseline; grey kicker partly cropped. At the end the lockup re-forms small as 'Work sprawl kills / AI productivity'.
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes into 'human productivity' as the black line drops into the 'o'; the frame dives through the blurred 'o' ring (which reads as a giant black donut at about 12.0 s) revealing a small new lockup inside, which resolves as 'Work sprawl kills / AI productivity' while the line curls away (w24-w25).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the type group about 8x toward the 'o' with a heavy ease-in and growing gaussian blur so the letter's counter becomes a portal, then cut to the same lockup with 'human' swapped for 'AI' scaling down from the portal centre to rest.

shots.focal_element: Tilted lockup 'Work sprawl kills / AI productivity' with the black line passing through the 'o'
shots.typography: Grey medium-weight kicker over a large heavy black 'AI productivity', sentence case, tight tracking, slight diagonal tilt; letters of 'productivity' wobble on the baseline before settling.
shots.what_happens: The 'AI productivity' lockup settles with letters jostling into line as the VO says w25-w26; the black line threads up into the 'o' (which briefly glows pale blue) and then swings away along a curve toward the lower left, setting up the next zoom.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the rotated two-line lockup on the textured white background, settle each letter of 'productivity' with a small overshoot spring on y and rotation, and animate a black SVG path with a dot head that passes through the 'o' counter and exits on a curve.
